title: a display with a wrong mode list is read again and the right size is drawn

clauses.text: a display whose mode list is wrong is read again by itself, and Settings, Display shows the size the shell is driving in Screen in use

steps.do: Plug in a 4K monitor on the HDMI port of the Mac mini, then wait about 15 seconds.
steps.expect: The picture is drawn at the best size the monitor offers, not at a blurred 1080p fallback.

steps.do: Open Settings, Display and read the Screen in use row. Then open Settings, Displays and press l (Look again).
steps.expect: Screen in use shows the size the picture is drawn at, and Look again keeps that size.
